Platform-attributed example; no independent generation was performed. The public original prompt is linked at the source rather than republished here. FrameMux describes a six-frame sprite sheet assembled into a loop by the browser. Archived moving files are animated WebP, not native GIF output from the model. Each animation has six 160 ms frames (960 ms total).
